title: Stuffed Bear (Container)

sources.title: Stuffed Bear (Container)
markers: '''Stuffed Bear''' is a common [[Miscellaneous]] item. It is a stuffed bear that contains a note, and can be used as a [[Containers|Container]], like a [[Backpack]].

summary: Portable inventory container disguised as a stuffed bear.

fields.Contents: Muddy Note. Can hold other items like a backpack.
fields.Acquisition: Shallow water at (82, 318) in the Sunlit Wetlands.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
